scope: Actual gate/up weights with natural per-expert count replay at M256 and M512. Timings include one BF16-to-D8 activation pack plus one or two selected gate/up launches.

candidate.geometry: MMQ128x64, local128, four wave32 column owners, direct T16 decode, split16 D8 arithmetic, activation double buffer, raw-prefetch P8
candidate.difference_from_prior_row64_screen: The prior row64 screen predates direct wave-column decode, activation double buffering, and the retained raw-prefetch P8 schedule.

decision: Reject and remove both the all-expert and density-partitioned row64 routes. The increased accumulator lifetime and second-launch cost exceed the reduced expert-weight rereads even when only 1-14 dense experts use row64.
